## Technical exercise

The former workshop notebook has moved to the [FHIR Bulk Data Technical Example](../../modules/bulk-fhir-tech.qmd). Use that maintained module for the interactive Bulk Data exercise.

The previous `notebook.ipynb`, NBViewer link, `requirements.txt` instructions, and `workshops/fhir-bulk-data` directory are no longer part of this repository.

For notebooks provided by other workshops, see [Running Workshop Notebooks](../running-notebooks.qmd).

## JKWS to PEM conversion

This workshop uses <https://bulk-data.smarthealthit.org> to provide a testing FHIR server. For convenience, this website will generate the public/private keypair in JWKS format. This has to be converted to PEM format for use in Python. [This web page](pem.html) can be used to do this.
